answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The voyage of work and the river of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a comet to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
